adaptations: pi-clm core source is maintained under src/context with canonical Midnight tools/commands, gated ownership, portable defaults and erasable TypeScript.
The pi-rewind checkpoint core was redesigned for bounded asynchronous Git operations, scoped journalled restores, HEAD preservation and session-specific retention; legacy metadata is read separately.
Steering is from the attributed CLM distribution. The skills are original Midnight workflows, not copies of personal connector skills.
